intended_object: The 1-morphisms of the bicategory Cat of (small) categories, i.e. functors C ⥤ D between two categories C and D (from the docstring).
explanation: The structure is a one-field wrapper with constructor `ofFunctor` and field `toFunctor : C ⥤ D`, so `Cat.Hom C D` corresponds exactly, one to one, with functors C ⥤ D. The wrapper only stops Lean from treating the two types as definitionally equal ("defeq-abuse"). The `@[ext]` attribute gives the right notion of equality: two morphisms are equal when their underlying functors are. The universe parameters (`Cat.{v, u}`) are fully general. It therefore faithfully represents the 1-morphisms of Cat.
